meta_description:
36K likes, 1,054 comments - sanjyotkeer on April 26, 2024: "GQ Most Influential Young Indian 2024! 💫

Honoured to be on the #GQpowerlist of the most influential young Indians. Received this award last night to recognise my work in promoting the power of regional Indian cuisine across the world and what could be a better day to receive it as it was YFL’s 8 year anniversary! ❤️

I always dreamed of showcasing Indian cuisine through my unique prospective, and 8 years back I embarked on this mission through Your Food Lab. I am grateful to have been able to share the flavours of India with kitchens around the world, reaching millions of households 🚀

Thank you to each one of you who got along on this journey with me and always a big thank you to my YFL team. 🤗🥰

This journey continues, let’s show the world the power of Indian regional cuisines! ❤️

@gqindia 

Wearing @ashay.newdelhi @ascend.rohank 
Styled by @malvika_tater Asst @vrutiiiiiiii 
Clicked by @fokuscreations 
.
.
[Indian cuisine, GQ, Most Influential Young Indian, Award]".
